person.en: Every person in the group was asked to share one idea.
person.zh: 小組中的每個人都被要求分享一個想法。

make.en: Small daily choices can make a big difference over time.
make.zh: 每天的小選擇久而久之可能帶來很大的改變。

use.en: Students can use this chart to compare the two results.
use.zh: 學生可以使用這張圖表比較兩個結果。

time.en: We still have enough time to finish the project carefully.
time.zh: 我們還有足夠的時間仔細完成這個專題。

other.en: Some students prefer reading, while other students learn better by listening.
other.zh: 有些學生偏好閱讀，而其他學生用聽的學得更好。

there.en: There are several ways to solve this problem correctly.
there.zh: 有好幾種方法可以正確解決這個問題。

year.en: Our school holds a science fair once every year.
year.zh: 我們學校每年舉辦一次科展。

good.en: A good study plan should include both practice and rest.
good.zh: 好的讀書計畫應同時包含練習與休息。

find.en: You can find useful information on the library website.
find.zh: 你可以在圖書館網站上找到實用資訊。

come.en: New ideas often come from asking simple but important questions.
come.zh: 新想法常來自提出簡單但重要的問題。

new.en: The school introduced a new course on environmental science this year.
new.zh: 學校今年開設了一門新的環境科學課程。

out.en: We went out after class to buy something to eat.
out.zh: 下課後我們出去買了些東西吃。

often.en: Students often remember new words better when they use them in context.
often.zh: 學生在語境中使用新單字時，通常會記得更牢。

around.en: We walked around the lake before returning to the bus.
around.zh: 我們繞著湖走了一圈才回到遊覽車。

water.en: Remember to drink enough water during long study sessions.
water.zh: 長時間讀書時要記得喝足夠的水。

however.en: The task looked difficult; however, we completed it on time.
however.zh: 這項任務看起來很困難；然而，我們仍準時完成了。

only.en: This ticket is only valid until the end of today.
only.zh: 這張票只有效到今天結束為止。

world.en: The internet allows people around the world to share information quickly.
world.zh: 網路讓世界各地的人能快速分享資訊。

get.en: You will get better results if you review a little every day.
get.zh: 如果你每天複習一點，就會得到更好的成果。

take.en: Please take a few minutes to check your answers again.
take.zh: 請花幾分鐘再檢查一次你的答案。

while.en: I listened to music while I was cleaning my room.
while.zh: 我整理房間時一邊聽音樂。

work.en: Group projects work best when everyone has a clear role.
work.zh: 每個人都有明確分工時，小組專題最容易順利進行。

know.en: It is useful to know why an answer is correct.
know.zh: 知道一個答案為什麼正確是很有幫助的。

go.en: We decided to go home before the weather became worse.
go.zh: 我們決定在天氣變差前先回家。

body.en: Regular sleep helps the body recover from a busy day.
body.zh: 規律睡眠有助於身體從忙碌的一天中恢復。

even.en: Even a short review can help you remember important ideas.
even.zh: 即使只是短暫複習，也能幫助你記住重要觀念。

mean.en: What does this sentence mean in the context of the passage?
mean.zh: 這個句子在文章語境中是什麼意思？

show.en: The results show that most students prefer shorter study sessions.
show.zh: 結果顯示，多數學生偏好較短的讀書時段。

human.en: Human behavior can change when the environment changes suddenly.
human.zh: 當環境突然改變時，人類行為也可能跟著改變。

like.en: Many students like to review vocabulary before going to bed.
like.zh: 許多學生喜歡在睡前複習單字。

see.en: You can see the difference clearly when the two charts are compared.
see.zh: 比較兩張圖表時，你可以清楚看出差異。

well.en: She explained the difficult idea so well that everyone understood it.
well.zh: 她把困難的觀念解釋得很好，因此大家都懂了。

country.en: Each country has its own traditions, laws, and education system.
country.zh: 每個國家都有自己的傳統、法律與教育制度。

information.en: The website provides useful information about scholarships and application deadlines.
information.zh: 這個網站提供有關獎學金與申請截止日期的實用資訊。

research.en: The students conducted research on how sleep affects learning and memory.
research.zh: 學生研究睡眠如何影響學習與記憶。

technology.en: New technology has changed the way people communicate across long distances.
technology.zh: 新科技已改變人們進行遠距溝通的方式。

decision.en: She considered several options carefully before making her final decision.
decision.zh: 她在做最後決定前仔細考慮了幾個選項。

method.en: The teacher introduced a simple method for remembering difficult vocabulary.
method.zh: 老師介紹了一個記住困難單字的簡單方法。

strategy.en: She changed her study strategy after noticing which methods worked best.
strategy.zh: 她發現哪些方法最有效後，調整了自己的讀書策略。

community.en: The new library has become an important place for the local community.
community.zh: 這座新圖書館已成為當地社區的重要場所。

experience.en: Traveling alone gave him valuable experience in solving unexpected problems.
experience.zh: 獨自旅行讓他獲得處理突發問題的寶貴經驗。

develop.en: Students need time to develop strong reading and writing skills.
develop.zh: 學生需要時間培養扎實的閱讀與寫作能力。

environment.en: A quiet environment can make it easier to focus on studying.
environment.zh: 安靜的環境能讓人更容易專心讀書。

evidence.en: The scientist looked for evidence before accepting the new explanation.
evidence.zh: 科學家在接受新的解釋前先尋找證據。

factor.en: Sleep is an important factor in both health and learning.
factor.zh: 睡眠是影響健康與學習的重要因素。

feature.en: One useful feature of the app is its offline mode.
feature.zh: 這個應用程式的一項實用功能是離線模式。

impact.en: Social media can have a strong impact on how people receive news.
impact.zh: 社群媒體可能大幅影響人們接收新聞的方式。

indicate.en: The survey results indicate that students want more practice time.
indicate.zh: 調查結果顯示，學生希望有更多練習時間。

individual.en: Each individual may respond differently to the same situation.
individual.zh: 每個人對同一情況可能有不同反應。

involve.en: The project will involve students from three different classes.
involve.zh: 這項專題將會有三個不同班級的學生參與。

issue.en: The class discussed an environmental issue that affects many cities.
issue.zh: 全班討論了一個影響許多城市的環境議題。

maintain.en: It is easier to maintain a habit when you practice it regularly.
maintain.zh: 規律練習會讓維持一個習慣變得更容易。

occur.en: Mistakes often occur when people work too quickly without checking details.
occur.zh: 人們做事太快又沒有檢查細節時，常會發生錯誤。

participate.en: More students decided to participate in the school volunteer program.
participate.zh: 更多學生決定參加學校的志工計畫。

provide.en: The guide provides clear instructions for completing each step.
provide.zh: 這份指南為完成每個步驟提供清楚的說明。

require.en: This assignment will require careful reading and clear written explanations.
require.zh: 這份作業需要仔細閱讀以及清楚的書面說明。

significant.en: The experiment showed a significant improvement after the method was changed.
significant.zh: 方法改變後，實驗顯示出明顯的改善。

specific.en: Please give a specific example to support your main point.
specific.zh: 請舉出一個具體例子來支持你的主要觀點。

suggest.en: The results suggest that regular practice improves long-term memory.
suggest.zh: 結果顯示，規律練習有助於提升長期記憶。

support.en: Good evidence can support an argument and make it more convincing.
support.zh: 良好的證據能支持論點，讓它更有說服力。

various.en: Students used various sources to complete their research project.
various.zh: 學生使用各種資料來源完成研究專題。

affect.en: Lack of sleep can affect both concentration and mood.
affect.zh: 睡眠不足會影響專注力與情緒。

approach.en: We tried a different approach when the first plan did not work.
approach.zh: 第一個計畫失敗後，我們改用不同的方法。

assume.en: Do not assume that an answer is correct without checking the evidence.
assume.zh: 不要在沒有檢查證據前就假設答案正確。

available.en: The new study room is available to students after school.
available.zh: 新的自習室放學後開放給學生使用。

benefit.en: Regular exercise can benefit both physical and mental health.
benefit.zh: 規律運動對身心健康都有好處。

challenge.en: Learning to manage time well is a common challenge for students.
challenge.zh: 學會做好時間管理是學生常見的挑戰。

consequence.en: One consequence of poor planning is having to rush at the end.
consequence.zh: 規劃不佳的一個後果是最後必須趕工。

consider.en: You should consider several choices before making an important decision.
consider.zh: 做重要決定前，你應該考慮幾個不同的選擇。

contribute.en: Every group member should contribute at least one useful idea.
contribute.zh: 每位組員都應至少貢獻一個有用的想法。

analyze.en: Students learned to analyze the data before drawing a conclusion.
analyze.zh: 學生學會在下結論前分析資料。

process.en: Learning a language is a gradual process that requires regular practice.
process.zh: 學習語言是一個需要規律練習的漸進過程。

result.en: The final result was better than we had expected.
result.zh: 最後的結果比我們原先預期的更好。

reason.en: There is a clear reason why this method works better.
reason.zh: 這個方法為什麼效果更好有一個明確的原因。

relationship.en: The study examined the relationship between exercise and sleep quality.
relationship.zh: 這項研究探討運動與睡眠品質之間的關係。

responsibility.en: Students have a responsibility to complete their own work honestly.
responsibility.zh: 學生有責任誠實完成自己的作業。

resource.en: The library website is a useful resource for finding reliable information.
resource.zh: 圖書館網站是尋找可靠資訊的實用資源。

response.en: Her response showed that she had understood the question clearly.
response.zh: 她的回答顯示她已清楚理解這個問題。

section.en: Read the first section carefully before answering the questions below.
section.zh: 回答下方問題前，請先仔細閱讀第一部分。

similar.en: The two experiments produced similar results under the same conditions.
similar.zh: 兩個實驗在相同條件下得到相似的結果。

situation.en: We need more information before we can understand the whole situation.
situation.zh: 我們需要更多資訊才能了解整個情況。

source.en: Always check whether a source is reliable before using its information.
source.zh: 使用資料前，務必先確認來源是否可靠。

standard.en: The final report must meet the standard required by the teacher.
standard.zh: 期末報告必須達到老師要求的標準。

structure.en: A clear structure makes an essay easier to read and understand.
structure.zh: 清楚的結構會讓文章更容易閱讀與理解。

system.en: The school introduced a new system for borrowing library books.
system.zh: 學校導入了一套新的圖書借閱系統。

theory.en: The experiment was designed to test whether the theory was correct.
theory.zh: 這個實驗是為了測試該理論是否正確。

trend.en: The chart shows a clear trend toward greater online learning.
trend.zh: 這張圖表顯示線上學習增加的明顯趨勢。

value.en: The teacher explained the value of checking evidence before making claims.
value.zh: 老師說明了提出主張前查證證據的重要性。

advantage.en: One advantage of studying in groups is sharing different ideas.
advantage.zh: 小組學習的一個優點是可以分享不同想法。

alternative.en: We need an alternative plan in case the weather gets worse.
alternative.zh: 我們需要一個備用方案，以防天氣變差。

amount.en: The amount of time needed depends on the difficulty of the task.
amount.zh: 所需時間多寡取決於任務的難度。

appropriate.en: Choose an appropriate example that clearly supports your answer.
appropriate.zh: 請選擇一個能清楚支持答案的適當例子。

attitude.en: A positive attitude can make difficult tasks feel more manageable.
attitude.zh: 正向的態度能讓困難的任務變得較容易應付。

behavior.en: The study focused on how stress influences student behavior.
behavior.zh: 這項研究著重於壓力如何影響學生行為。

circumstance.en: Under this circumstance, waiting for more information is the safest choice.
circumstance.zh: 在這種情況下，等待更多資訊是最安全的選擇。

concept.en: The teacher used a simple diagram to explain the concept.
concept.zh: 老師用簡單的圖示解釋這個概念。

condition.en: The plants grew well under the right temperature and light conditions.
condition.zh: 植物在適當的溫度與光照條件下生長良好。

context.en: You can often guess a word's meaning from the context around it.
context.zh: 你常可以從周圍的語境猜出單字的意思。

contrast.en: The essay draws a clear contrast between city and country life.
contrast.zh: 這篇文章清楚對比城市與鄉村生活。

define.en: The teacher asked us to define the term in our own words.
define.zh: 老師要我們用自己的話定義這個術語。

demonstrate.en: The experiment can demonstrate how pressure changes the behavior of gases.
demonstrate.zh: 這個實驗可以示範壓力如何改變氣體的行為。

distribution.en: The graph shows the distribution of scores across the whole class.
distribution.zh: 這張圖表顯示全班分數的分布情形。

economic.en: The report discusses several economic problems facing the country.
economic.zh: 這份報告討論該國面臨的幾項經濟問題。

establish.en: The school hopes to establish a stronger reading culture among students.
establish.zh: 學校希望在學生之間建立更強的閱讀風氣。

estimate.en: We can estimate the total cost before making the final decision.
estimate.zh: 我們可以在做最後決定前估算總成本。

function.en: This button has a useful function that saves your recent work.
function.zh: 這個按鈕有一項實用功能，可以儲存你最近的工作。

identify.en: Students should identify the main idea before reading the details.
identify.zh: 學生應先找出主旨，再閱讀細節。

likely.en: Students who review regularly are more likely to remember new vocabulary.
likely.zh: 規律複習的學生更可能記住新單字。

major.en: Traffic is a major problem in many large cities.
major.zh: 交通是許多大城市的一項主要問題。

measure.en: The experiment used a digital scale to measure the amount of water.
measure.zh: 實驗使用電子秤測量水的量。

potential.en: The new plan has the potential to improve student participation.
potential.zh: 這項新計畫有提升學生參與度的潛力。

principle.en: The teacher explained the basic principle behind the experiment.
principle.zh: 老師解釋了這項實驗背後的基本原理。

role.en: Parents can play an important role in supporting a student's learning.
role.zh: 家長可以在支持學生學習方面扮演重要角色。

vary.en: Study methods may vary depending on the subject and the student.
vary.zh: 讀書方法可能因科目與學生而有所不同。
